root_cause: The tab keyboard navigation (_keydown) uses _getChildren which includes disabled tabs, causing ArrowRight to move focus to the disabled Notifications tab instead of skipping it.
repair_strategy: Modify _getChildren to return only enabled tabs by filtering out elements where isDisabled returns true, ensuring keyboard navigation skips disabled tabs.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight will skip the disabled Notifications tab and move focus to the Billing tab, updating aria-selected to true on Billing and showing its panel.
functional_risks: Disabled tabs may miss initial attribute setup (tabindex, aria-selected, role) but remain inert due to the disabled attribute.
Ensure that disabling a tab via the disabled attribute continues to prevent focus and activation.
verification_requirements: Verify that ArrowRight from the Account tab moves focus to the Billing tab (skipping Notifications).
Verify that ArrowLeft from the Billing tab wraps to the Account tab.
Confirm the disabled Notifications tab remains unfocusable and its panel stays hidden.
Ensure initial state (Account tab selected, Billing panel hidden) is unchanged.
